integrity: The mathematical proof and reproducibility code accompany the finding; self-review do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The closed-form rigidity theorem assumes an ordinal sum of h>=1 equal antichains, each width m>=2. The nonuniform dynamic recurrence applies to arbitrary positive widths but may have exponentially many states. General results are established by proof rather than finite tests; originality is subject to possible older unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Frontier rigidity and exact Heyting endomorphism-rank census for finite weak orders
